title: Cross-lingual Zero- and Few-shot Hate Speech Detection utilising frozen Transformer Language Models and AXEL

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating hate speech detection models on a dataset of English and Spanish tweets targeting women (HatEval) and conducting an error analysis on false positive predictions triggered by out-of-domain sampling of gender-associated keywords (e.g., 'bitch').

Evaluating hate speech detection models on English and Spanish tweets targeting immigrants, analyzing model performance and false positive rates linked to specific anti-immigration phrases (e.g., 'illegal aliens', 'build the wall').
